title: 纽扣电池：内阻看得见
summary: CR2032 有约 15 Ω 内阻：一取电流，端电压就往下掉。但这不是省掉限流电阻的理由。
description: 真实电池可以看成“理想电压源 + 一个内阻”。CR2032 的内阻约 15 Ω：电流流过内阻会吃掉一部分电压，端电压就低于 3 V。电路：CR2032 → 47 Ω → 红色 LED → GND。

cards.title: 电池也会“累”
text: 这一题没有步骤，**照目标电路图自己搭**。先选「电池」，在「属性」里把型号改成 **CR2032**。搭好后用万用表量电池两端。

cards.title: 真实电池 = 理想电源 + 内阻
text: - 把电池想成一个**理想的 3 V 电源，里面串着一个小电阻**（内阻 $r$）。
- 有电流时，内阻上会掉一点电压，所以电池两端的**端电压**比 3 V 低：
$$V_{bat} = 3\ \text{V} - I \cdot r$$
- 网上常说“纽扣电池可以直接点 LED，不用电阻”。算一算：不加电阻时 $I \approx \frac{3 - 1.8}{15 + 12} \approx 44$ mA——比 LED 的 20 mA 大一倍多，纽扣电池也吃不消。加 47 Ω 就合适了。

cards.title: 搭好，量三个数
text: - 47 Ω 电阻的一只脚可以直接插红轨。
- 用万用表量电池两端，再单击 LED 读电流。最后用这两个数**算出内阻**。

cards.title: 带走
text: - 每种电池都有内阻：9 V 方块约 1.5 Ω，AA 每节约 0.15 Ω，CR2032 约 15 Ω。**内阻越大，越带不动大电流。**
- 用“端电压随电流下降多少”就能测出内阻——你刚才做的就是这件事。
- 电池快没电时内阻会变大，所以“空载量着还有 3 V”的旧电池，一接负载电压就塌。

en.title: Coin cell: internal resistance you can see
en.summary: A CR2032 has about 15 Ω of internal resistance: draw current and its terminal voltage sags. That is still no excuse to skip the LED's resistor.
en.description: A real battery behaves like an ideal voltage source plus an internal resistance. A CR2032 has about 15 Ω: the current through it eats some voltage, so the terminal voltage is below 3 V. Circuit: CR2032 → 47 Ω → red LED → GND.
hints: Click the battery and set its type to CR2032 in Properties.
One leg of the 47 Ω resistor can go straight into the red rail.
tests: LED on, battery terminal voltage pulled down by its internal resistance

cards.title: Batteries get "tired" too
text: No steps here — **build it from the target schematic**. Pick Battery and set its type to **CR2032** in Properties. Then measure across the battery with the multimeter.

cards.title: Real battery = ideal source + internal resistance
text: - Think of the battery as an **ideal 3 V source with a small resistor inside** (the internal resistance $r$).
- With current flowing, the internal resistance takes a little voltage, so the battery's **terminal voltage** is below 3 V:
$$V_{bat} = 3\ \text{V} - I \cdot r$$

- You will read online that "a coin cell can drive an LED without a resistor". Do the sum: with no resistor $I \approx \frac{3 - 1.8}{15 + 12} \approx 44$ mA — more than twice an LED's 20 mA, and too much for a coin cell. 47 Ω gets it right.

cards.title: Build it, measure three numbers
text: - One leg of the 47 Ω resistor can go straight into the red rail.
- Measure across the battery with the multimeter, then click the LED for its current. Finally **work out the internal resistance** from the two.

cards.title: Take away
text: - Every battery has internal resistance: about 1.5 Ω for a 9 V block, 0.15 Ω per AA cell, 15 Ω for a CR2032. **The bigger it is, the less current the battery can deliver.**
- How far the terminal voltage drops with current tells you the internal resistance — exactly what you just did.
- A nearly flat battery has a bigger internal resistance, which is why an old cell that "still reads 3 V" with nothing connected collapses as soon as you load it.

measurements.ask: Multimeter: the voltage across the battery (red probe on the + rail)
measurements.explain: I ≈ (3 − 1.8) / (15 + 47 + 12) ≈ 16.2 mA; the internal resistance takes 15 Ω × 16.2 mA ≈ 0.24 V, leaving about 2.76 V.

measurements.ask: Click the LED: the current in Properties
From your two readings, the internal resistance: r = (3 V − terminal voltage) / current
measurements.explain: About 15 Ω: the internal resistance of a CR2032.

tests.name: LED 亮，电池端电压被内阻拉低

measurements.ask: 万用表：电池两端的电压（红表笔在 + 轨）
单击 LED：「属性」里的电流
用你的两个读数算电池内阻：r = (3 V − 端电压) / 电流
measurements.explain: 约 15 Ω：这就是 CR2032 的内阻。

hints: 选中电池，在属性里把型号改成 CR2032。
47 Ω 电阻的一只脚可以直接插红轨。
